The proof includes summability and boundary cases; a 90-family finite checker independently tests formulas but does not substitute for infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A source-motivated white-noise/isotropic one-coordinate sketch raises a precise allocation problem for a natural compact Hilbert--Schmidt operator. The exact optimized law and rho-dependent sharp asymptotic cost quantify the price of repeated iid sparse coordinate sampling versus deterministic rank truncation. The nonattainment of isotropic optimal designs supplies a structural boundary, rather than an arbitrary numerical case. Scope does not extend to general sketches.
